note: turn.onBegin now gates on the play phase and skips the draw only on G.firstPlayTurn (recorded when play opens), so the starting player keeps 7 and the second player draws to 8. Test asserts both.

blockers is now a declared stage (block moves only), so the defender can't forceEndTurn mid-combat. forceEndTurn RESOLVES a pending attack instead of discarding it, and confirmAttackers refreshes turnDeadline + sets blockDeadline. Tested.

Server claimTimeout now targets whoever holds priority: while an attack is pending only the attacker may claim against the defender; otherwise only the non-current player may claim against the current player. Stalling defender can no longer time out the attacker.

drawCard no longer derives a mill-out loss on a client view: when the stripped deck is empty but G.deckCounts says >0 it no-ops (the master decides deck-out). Stops the self-loss flash on every online draw without disabling optimistic play.
Instance uid counter moved into G.nextUid (was a module global that reset on restart and collided with persisted matches). mkInstance/newUid take G. Test asserts c1 + G.nextUid.

starterDeck derives node count as 60-spells (floor 18) and trims only surplus nodes, never the tail, so every aura (and Knowledge's Arcane Storm) is in its starter. cards.test asserts every non-node card appears.
Server cards.ts re-synced from the client copy (base_moose now present, chain-era names gone, starter matches). Kept the vendored header + the one noUncheckedIndexedAccess fix.
Server Game.ts regenerated from the client file so the rules are identical except the documented server-only deltas (claimTimeout, endIf reason, .js imports).

Combat damage is cleared at resolveCombat end as before; the review's concern was post-combat persistence across turns. Damage already resets each resolveCombat and turn.onEnd clears combat; left the per-turn model as-is since no multi-combat path exists after the stage fix. Flagged as low.
Damage moves now validate the target (either player or an actual meme) BEFORE paying, so a stale/bogus uid returns INVALID_MOVE and keeps the card + gas. Tested.
No per-turn combat flag added; the declared blockers stage + goToCombat guard already prevent re-entering combat with zero attackers. Left as-is (low).
Added a discardCard(handIndex) move (legal only while hand>7) and passTurn/forceEndTurn now discard from the FRONT (oldest) instead of popping the newest draw. Tested.
blockers stage is now explicitly declared with a narrow move set (declareBlocker/confirmBlocks/announceVoicePeer/concede), not boardgame.io fallthrough.
Bot owned by the bot file; its Math.random->seeded change was briefed to the board/engine test work. Not changed in this pass — bot.ts left for its owner; recorded so it isn't lost.
Bot enumerateMoves second-attacker gap: bot.ts not changed this pass (see engine-15).
Mulligan 10s deadline / force-keep race unchanged; low severity, left as-is.
etb_zap_2_and_draw now routes through dealDamageToPlayer so the damage log line fires and future player-damage hooks see it.

Added src/Game.test.ts (11 tests) driving the real reducer: opening hands, no turn-one draw, deterministic uids, the combat-stall exploits, damage targeting, discard, concede, voice announce + spectator strip. All pass.
src/collection.ts is the client-api owner's file; the stale-identity fix is in their brief.
Catalogue duplication resolved: server cards.ts is now a clean re-sync of the client with only the documented header + type-only fix. Drift eliminated.
concede move added to the client Game.ts (was server-only); sets own life to 0, endReason='concede'. Registered in play phase + afk/blockers stages. Tested (ends with winner=opponent).
announceVoicePeer(peerId) move + G.voice map added; validates id charset/length; playerView strips voice for spectators (playerID null) so only the two seats learn peer ids. Tested both.
